answers.explanation: The passage calls the earth the moon's near neighbour, showing the earth is nearer to the moon than the sun is.
The sentence means it is a common belief that the moon has magical powers.
Either quest refers to the search for the origin of the moon or of the earth.
The passage presents facts about the moon, its light, its origin and its effect on the tides.
Protagonists are the supporters who defend capitalism.
Supporters claim the essential characteristic of capitalism is economic freedom.
The producer is free to produce whatever goods the marketer chooses.
The market mechanism harmonizes the whims and caprices of both producers and consumers.
It is the market mechanism that determines prices.
The share of the total output goes to each factor of production.
The four recognized factors of production are land, labour, capital and organization.
Injustice is done by the operations of the market mechanism.
The mechanism tends to bring about equilibrium between producers and consumers.
The writer calls his father uncommon, which means remarkable.

The passage centres on the father, who was an uncommon man.
The wolf charges the lamb with muddying the water, insolence, obstructing the path and aggression.

When the excuse failed, the wolf went on to invent a new charge, so he made up the charges.
